link.label: Link address
link.invalid: Only http(s), mailto, on-site (/...) and in-page (#...) links are supported.

upload.fileHelp: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; at most 5 MB. Uploaded files are served from a public address.
upload.fileTooLarge: The file can be at most 5 MB.

image.caption: Caption (optional)
image.altRequired: Enter alt text or mark the image as decorative.

video.title: Video title

video.titleRequired: Enter a title that describes the video for screen readers.

cover.label: Cover image (optional)
cover.help: Shown cropped to 16:9 in the post header, listing cards and sharing previews.
cover.altHelp: May stay empty in a draft; required for publishing.
